# Mizon SDK instructions

Follow the repository's [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md), [collaboration workflow](../docs/ai/COLLABORATION.md), [project map](../docs/ai/PROJECT.md), and [handoff](../docs/ai/HANDOFF.md).

Use these shared sources instead of inventing tool-specific rules. Preserve typed operations, generated JSON metadata, cancellation and ownership. Coordinate server DTOs and Windows MCP contracts when behavior changes. A completed implementation includes a precise scoped commit and push under the user's standing authorization; never include another assistant's unfinished changes by default.
